---
title: "landcover_data_cleaning"
format: pdf
editor: visual
---

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

#Nine land cover classes were mapped: (1) structures, (2) impervious surfaces, (3) water, (4) grassland/prairie, (5) tree canopy, (6) irrigated lands/turf, (7) barren/rock, (8) cropland, and (9) shrubland/scrubland

read.csv("./raw_extracts/lc_fracs_by_circle_FULL.csv") %>% 
  rename(structures = class_1,
         impervious_surfaces = class_2,
         water_90m = class_3,
         prairie_grassland = class_4,
         tree_canopy_90m = class_5,
         irrigated_land = class_6,
         barren_rock = class_7,
         cropland = class_8,
         scrubland = class_9) %>% 
  mutate(unirrigated_90m = rowSums(across(c(prairie_grassland, scrubland, barren_rock)), 
                               na.rm = TRUE),
         irrigated_90m = rowSums(across(c(cropland, irrigated_land)), 
                             na.rm = TRUE),
         impervious_90m = rowSums(across(c(impervious_surfaces, structures)), 
                              na.rm = TRUE),
         pervious_90m = rowSums(across(c(prairie_grassland, scrubland, cropland, irrigated_land, tree_canopy_90m)), 
                              na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  select(UID, unirrigated_90m, irrigated_90m, impervious_90m, pervious_90m, 
         tree_canopy_90m, water_90m) -> lc_90 
  

read_rds("./raw_extracts/lc_fracs_by_circle_FULL_250m.rds") %>% 
  mutate(
    unirrigated_250m = rowSums(across(c(`lc_250m_Grassland/Prairie`, 
                                        `lc_250m_Barren Rock`, 
                                        `lc_250m_Scrubland/Shrubland`)), 
                               na.rm = TRUE),
    irrigated_250m = rowSums(across(c(lc_250m_Cropland, 
                                      `lc_250m_Irrigated Lands/Turf`)), 
                             na.rm = TRUE),
    impervious_250m = rowSums(across(c(lc_250m_Structures, 
                                       `lc_250m_Impervious Surfaces`)), 
                              na.rm = TRUE),
    tree_canopy_250m = `lc_250m_Tree Canopy`,
    water_250m = `lc_250m_Water`  # Add backticks if column name has spaces 
    ) %>% 
  select(UID, unirrigated_250m, irrigated_250m, impervious_250m, 
         tree_canopy_250m, water_250m) -> lc_250

read_rds("./raw_extracts/lc_fracs_by_circle_FULL_30m.rds") %>% 
  mutate(
    unirrigated_30m = rowSums(across(c(`lc_30m_Grassland/Prairie`, 
                                        `lc_30m_Barren Rock`, 
                                        `lc_30m_Scrubland/Shrubland`)), 
                               na.rm = TRUE),
    irrigated_30m = rowSums(across(c(lc_30m_Cropland, 
                                      `lc_30m_Irrigated Lands/Turf`)), 
                             na.rm = TRUE),
    impervious_30m = rowSums(across(c(lc_30m_Structures, 
                                       `lc_30m_Impervious Surfaces`)), 
                              na.rm = TRUE),
    tree_canopy_30m = `lc_30m_Tree Canopy`,
    water_30m = `lc_30m_Water`  # Add backticks if column name has spaces 
    ) %>% 
  select(UID, unirrigated_30m, irrigated_30m, impervious_30m, 
         tree_canopy_30m, water_30m) -> lc_30

read_rds("./raw_extracts/lc_fracs_by_circle_FULL_90m_30m_donut.rds") %>% 
  mutate(
    unirrigated_30_90m = rowSums(across(c(`lc_30_90m_Grassland/Prairie`, 
                                        `lc_30_90m_Barren Rock`, 
                                        `lc_30_90m_Scrubland/Shrubland`)), 
                               na.rm = TRUE),
    irrigated_30_90m = rowSums(across(c(lc_30_90m_Cropland, 
                                      `lc_30_90m_Irrigated Lands/Turf`)), 
                             na.rm = TRUE),
    impervious_30_90m = rowSums(across(c(lc_30_90m_Structures, 
                                       `lc_30_90m_Impervious Surfaces`)), 
                              na.rm = TRUE),
    tree_canopy_30_90m = `lc_30_90m_Tree Canopy`,
    water_30_90m = `lc_30_90m_Water`  # Add backticks if column name has spaces 
    ) %>% 
  select(UID, unirrigated_30_90m, irrigated_30_90m, impervious_30_90m, 
         tree_canopy_30_90m, water_30_90m) -> lc_30_90

left_join(lc_90, lc_250, by = "UID") %>% 
  left_join(lc_30, by = "UID") %>% 
  left_join(lc_30_90, by = "UID") %>% 
  write_rds("./cleaned_data/land_cover.rds")

```
